recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-3122 unless a future decision reintroduces a local Encounter.priority value set.
issue_request: FHIR-3122 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Encounter and asked that the old Encounter.priority value set stop declaring http://hl7.org/fhir/diet as its code system and instead use an Encounter Priority URL.
initial_application: Jira comments say the issue was updated as part of tracker #2968. Git history confirms commit 1cf591a5ee changed the old valueset-encounter-priority name from Diet to Encounter Priority and moved the system away from diet, while commit 7e4c173af1 corrected the system to http://hl7.org/fhir/encounter-priority.
additional_context: FHIR-2968 is the same-change-family tracker for the copied Diet metadata. Later FHIR-8621/source history removed the local encounter-priority value set entirely and changed Encounter.priority to bind to v3 ActPriority; FHIR-9337 was only the Patient marital-status half of the same mixed commit and is not Encounter-related.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source has Encounter listed in source/fhir.ini and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml binds Encounter.priority to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActPriority, with no current source reference to the obsolete Encounter Priority value set or http://hl7.org/fhir/diet for this element.
